keywords.name: Physical Damage
keywords.definition: One of the five Damage Types; the most common, and the only one reduced by Armour rather than Resistance.

keywords.name: Fire Damage
keywords.definition: One of the five Damage Types; reduced by Fire Resistance; Fire Hits inflict Flammability based on damage dealt.

keywords.name: Cold Damage
keywords.definition: One of the five Damage Types; reduced by Cold Resistance; Cold Hits apply Chill and build Freeze but cannot build Heavy Stun.

keywords.name: Lightning Damage
keywords.definition: One of the five Damage Types; reduced by Lightning Resistance; Lightning Hits have a chance to Shock based on damage dealt.

keywords.name: Chaos Damage
keywords.definition: One of the five Damage Types; reduced by Chaos Resistance; least common, and removes twice as much Energy Shield as its value.

keywords.name: Ailments
keywords.definition: Family of common Debuffs tied to damage types: Bleeding, Ignite, Chill, Freeze, Shock, Electrocute and Poison.

keywords.name: Attributes
keywords.definition: Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence are the 3 primary attributes, mainly used to meet equipment and gem requirements.

keywords.name: Strength
keywords.definition: Attribute required for Armour equipment and melee-aligned weapons and skills; "+2 to maximum Life per 1 Strength".

keywords.name: Dexterity
keywords.definition: Attribute required for Evasion equipment and range-aligned weapons and skills; "+8 to Accuracy Rating per 1 Dexterity".

keywords.name: Intelligence
keywords.definition: Attribute required for Energy Shield equipment and spell-aligned weapons and skills; "+2 to maximum Mana per 1 Intelligence".

keywords.name: Bleeding
keywords.definition: Ailment dealing Physical damage over time, lasting 5 seconds by default; 100% extra damage while the target is moving or Aggravated.

keywords.name: Blind
keywords.definition: Causes 20% less Accuracy and Evasion Rating, lasting 4 seconds unless specified.

keywords.name: Chill
keywords.definition: Ailment that Slows the target, lasting 2 seconds on players or 8 on non-players by default; Magnitude minimum 30%, default maximum 50%.

keywords.name: Chilled Ground
keywords.definition: Chills those standing in it; lasts 6 seconds by default.

keywords.name: Consecrated Ground
keywords.definition: Allies standing in it Regenerate 5% of maximum Life per second, and Curses have 50% reduced effect on them.

keywords.name: Culling Strike
keywords.definition: Kills Normal enemies at 35% Life or below; Magic 20%, Rare 10%, Unique 5%; checked before Hit damage is applied.

keywords.name: Decimating Strike
keywords.definition: Hits against Full Life enemies remove between 5% and 30% of Life before the Hit damage is applied.

keywords.name: Damage Types
keywords.definition: The damage types are Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning and Chaos.

keywords.name: Damaging Ailments
keywords.definition: Ailments that deal damage: Bleeding, Ignite and Poison.

keywords.name: Desecrated Ground
keywords.definition: You take Chaos damage over time while standing in Desecrated Ground.

keywords.name: Elemental Ailments
keywords.definition: Ignite, Chill, Freeze, Shock and Electrocute.

keywords.name: Freeze
keywords.definition: Ailment that stops targets moving or acting, lasting 4 seconds by default; Cold Hits contribute to buildup until Frozen.

keywords.name: Hinder
keywords.definition: Debuff that Slows movement speed by 30% unless specified; lasts 4 seconds unless specified.

keywords.name: Ignite
keywords.definition: Ailment dealing Fire damage over time, lasting 4 seconds by default; Magnitude is 20% of the Hit's Fire damage.

keywords.name: Flammability
keywords.definition: Debuff providing the chance for Hits to Ignite; base 1% chance per 5% of Ailment Threshold dealt as Fire; 8 seconds by default.

keywords.name: Ignoring Resistances
keywords.definition: Your damage cannot be modified in any way by the target's Resistance stats.

keywords.name: Knockback
keywords.definition: Pushes Enemies away when Hit.

keywords.name: Life Leech
keywords.definition: Recovers Life as a percentage of damage dealt over one second; damage capped at 40,000 for the calculation; one instance at a time.

keywords.name: Low Energy Shield
keywords.definition: You are on Low Energy Shield at 35% of maximum Energy Shield or less.

keywords.name: Low Life
keywords.definition: A player or monster is on Low Life at 35% of maximum Life or less.

keywords.name: Low Mana
keywords.definition: You are on Low Mana at 35% of maximum Mana or less.

keywords.name: Lucky
keywords.definition: Lucky things are rolled twice and the better result used.

keywords.name: Maim
keywords.definition: Maimed enemies suffer 30% Slower Movement Speed and 15% reduced Evasion Rating; lasts 4 seconds unless specified.

keywords.name: Mana Leech
keywords.definition: Recovers Mana as a percentage of damage dealt over one second; same 40,000 cap; one instance at a time.

keywords.name: Rage Leech
keywords.definition: Recovers Rage as a percentage of damage dealt over one second; same 40,000 cap.

keywords.name: Map Owner
keywords.definition: The player who created the Map area.

keywords.name: Non-Damaging Ailments
keywords.definition: Chill, Freeze, Shock and Electrocute.

keywords.name: Overkill
keywords.definition: Hit damage in excess of the enemy's remaining Life when it is killed.

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.definition: Ailment dealing Chaos damage over time, lasting 2 seconds by default; bypasses Energy Shield.

keywords.name: Rage
keywords.definition: Grants 1% more Attack damage per Rage; default maximum 30; lose 1 Rage every 0.2 seconds.

keywords.name: Recently
keywords.definition: Refers to the past 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Shapeshifting
keywords.definition: Changes you into a non-human form; skills incompatible with the form shift you back to human.

keywords.name: Shock
keywords.definition: Ailment causing targets to take 20% increased damage; 4 seconds on players, 8 on non-players; 1% chance per 4% of Ailment Threshold dealt as Lightning.

keywords.name: Smoke Clouds
keywords.definition: Enemies standing in them are Blinded; radius 2 metres unless otherwise specified.

keywords.name: Player Stun Threshold
keywords.definition: Base equal to maximum Life; a Hit dealing at least that stuns you; chance scales down linearly; under 10% treated as 0%.

keywords.name: Enemy Stun Threshold
keywords.definition: The lower an enemy's Stun Threshold, the less Stun buildup is needed to Stun or Heavy Stun them.

keywords.name: Freeze Threshold
keywords.definition: Determines how much Freeze buildup is needed to Freeze a target.

keywords.name: Electrocute Threshold
keywords.definition: Determines how much Electrocute buildup is needed to Electrocute a target.

keywords.name: Unaffected
keywords.definition: Debuffs you are Unaffected by can still be placed on you but will not apply their effect.

keywords.name: Uncapped Resistance
keywords.definition: The value a Resistance would have ignoring Maximum Resistance; shown in parentheses on the Character Panel.

keywords.name: Overcapped Resistance
keywords.definition: Amount by which Uncapped Resistance exceeds Maximum Resistance for that damage type.

keywords.name: Unlucky
keywords.definition: Unlucky things are rolled twice and the worse result used.

keywords.name: Immobilised
keywords.definition: A target that cannot move, e.g. due to being Frozen, Pinned, Heavy Stunned or Electrocuted.

keywords.name: Stun
keywords.definition: Hits can Stun depending on damage dealt; two types: Light Stuns (brief, frequent) and Heavy Stuns (multi-second).

keywords.name: Light Stun
keywords.definition: Any Hit can Light Stun; base chance up to 100% for Hits dealing 100% of max Life; chances under 15% treated as 0%.

keywords.name: Heavy Stun
keywords.definition: Occurs when a Stun bar fills; interrupts action for a few seconds; Immobilised while stunned; players usually cannot be Heavily Stunned.

keywords.name: Player Heavy Stun
keywords.definition: Players usually cannot be Heavily Stunned except while specific actions (raising Shield, Buckler Parry, mount); cannot Block, Deflect or Evade while Heavily Stunned.

keywords.name: Electrocution
keywords.definition: Ailment interrupting actions and preventing any action, lasting 5 seconds by default; only specific Lightning sources build it.

keywords.name: Pinned
keywords.definition: Built up by certain skills; Pinned for 3 seconds (no moving, being moved or Evading) and Light Stunned on becoming Pinned.

keywords.name: Overwhelm
keywords.definition: Negates a certain amount of the target's Physical damage reduction, never more than they have.

keywords.name: Melee
keywords.definition: Direct Strike or Slam hits dealing Melee damage; Projectiles created by them do not count as Melee.

keywords.name: Slams
keywords.definition: Melee Attacks causing damaging areas of effect rather than Striking directly.

keywords.name: Chain
keywords.definition: Effects redirect to another target after colliding; Projectile chain distance 6 metres, other effects 4 metres.

keywords.name: Pierce
keywords.definition: Projectiles that Pierce pass through a target while still damaging them.

keywords.name: Fork
keywords.definition: Projectiles that Fork split into two the first time they collide with an enemy.

keywords.name: Split
keywords.definition: First collision splits the Projectile or beam into multiple, aimed at different targets within 6 metres.

keywords.name: Deflect
keywords.definition: Deflection Rating gives a chance to Deflect Hits, preventing 40% of their damage; depends on attacker's Accuracy.

keywords.name: Suppress
keywords.definition: 50% of damage from Suppressed Hits and Ailments they inflict is prevented.

keywords.name: Block
keywords.definition: Completely prevents an incoming Hit's damage; Stun still applies; cannot Block while Stunned or Frozen.

keywords.name: Chance to Block
keywords.definition: Includes only explicitly chance-based modifiers; guaranteed Block (e.g. raising Shield) does not affect it.

keywords.name: Overcapped Block Chance
keywords.definition: Amount by which Chance to Block would exceed maximum if uncapped.

keywords.name: Strike
keywords.definition: A Melee attack that directly hits with weapons or body parts; Slams are not Strikes.

keywords.name: Projectile
keywords.definition: A moving Attack or Spell that usually impacts targets; only one Projectile in a group can hit each target unless specified.

keywords.name: Resistances
keywords.definition: Reduce damage of Fire, Cold, Lightning or Chaos up to a Maximum; Elemental Resistances are lowered as you progress.

keywords.name: Critical Hits
keywords.definition: Deal +100% extra damage by default; Critical Damage Bonuses can further modify this.

keywords.name: Critical Damage Bonus
keywords.definition: Multiplies damage dealt by Critical Hits; default +100%.

keywords.name: Jagged Ground
keywords.definition: Slows enemies' movement speed in its area by 20%.

keywords.name: Totems
keywords.definition: Allied constructs that use skills for you; not Minions; Totem Limit is shared between types by default.

keywords.name: Taunt
keywords.definition: Taunted enemies can only target you and deal 10% less damage with Hits to anyone else; 3 seconds by default.

keywords.name: Empowered Skills
keywords.definition: Do not have inherent bonuses, but specific stats and modifiers apply to them.

keywords.name: Monster Power
keywords.definition: Number reflecting monster strength (average 1); multiplied by Rarity: Normal 1, Magic 2, Rare 5; Unique always 20.

keywords.name: Armour
keywords.definition: Reduces damage taken from Hits; by default only applies to Physical; more effective against smaller hits.

keywords.name: Burning
keywords.definition: Enemies taking Fire damage over time; usually because they are Ignited.

keywords.name: Frozen
keywords.definition: A Frozen target cannot move or act; reached at 100% Freeze buildup.

keywords.name: Evasion
keywords.definition: Evasion Rating grants a chance to Evade Hits; exact chance also depends on attacker's Accuracy.

keywords.name: Accuracy
keywords.definition: Used to hit with Attacks and checked against Evasion; Player Attacks lose up to 90% Accuracy beyond 9 metres.

keywords.name: Energy Shield
keywords.definition: Protects Life by taking damage instead; recharges if not lost for a short time; Chaos removes twice as much; Bleeding and Poison bypass it.

keywords.name: Primed for Electrocution
keywords.definition: Normal enemies at 40% Electrocution buildup; Magic 50%, Rare 60%, Unique 70%.

keywords.name: Primed for Stun
keywords.definition: Normal enemies at 40% Heavy Stun buildup; Magic 50%, Rare 60%, Unique 70%.

keywords.name: Primed for Freeze
keywords.definition: Normal enemies at 40% Freeze buildup; Magic 50%, Rare 60%, Unique 70%.

keywords.name: Iron Reflexes
keywords.definition: Converts all Evasion Rating to Armour.

keywords.name: Slow
keywords.definition: Debuff modifiers making actions take longer; multiplicative; 15% less effect on Magic, 30% less on Rare, 50% less on Unique; minimum 25% of base speed.

keywords.name: Rarity
keywords.definition: Items or monsters can be Normal, Magic, Rare or Unique; higher-rarity monsters are more difficult.

keywords.name: Faster Start of Energy Shield Recharge
keywords.definition: Affects the delay before Energy Shield starts Recharging after losing it.

keywords.name: Energy Shield Recharge Rate
keywords.definition: Affects how quickly Energy Shield is recovered once Recharging starts.

keywords.name: Hit Damage
keywords.definition: Any damage that isn't damage over time.

keywords.name: Spells
keywords.definition: Skills using raw magic; have their own base damage, cast speed and Critical Hit chance; Attacks are not Spells.

keywords.name: Attacks
keywords.definition: Skills directly damaging enemies, usually using your Martial Weapon; Spells are not Attacks.

keywords.name: Traps
keywords.definition: Two-Handed ranged weapons requiring Dexterity and Intelligence; placed on the ground and detonated or triggered by nearby enemies.

keywords.name: Withered
keywords.definition: Applies 5% increased Chaos damage taken per stack; can be inflicted up to 10 times.

keywords.name: Crushed
keywords.definition: Lowers Physical Damage Reduction by 15%; can make it negative.

keywords.name: Crushing Blows
keywords.definition: Cause a Heavy Stun on enemies Primed for Stun.

keywords.name: Brittle
keywords.definition: Hits have up to +6% Critical Hit Chance against Brittle enemies, based on the Hit's Cold damage, for 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Quest Item
keywords.definition: Used to progress the story; cannot be sold or stashed; can be discarded and reobtained.

keywords.name: Swords
keywords.definition: Melee weapons, One-Handed or Two-Handed; require Strength and Dexterity.

keywords.name: Maces
keywords.definition: Melee weapons, One-Handed or Two-Handed; require Strength.

keywords.name: Sceptres
keywords.definition: One-Handed weapons requiring Strength and Intelligence; grant Spirit and Ally bonuses; cannot be used to Attack.

keywords.name: Wands
keywords.definition: One-Handed spellcasting weapons requiring Intelligence; cannot be Dual Wielded or used to Attack directly.

keywords.name: Axes
keywords.definition: Melee weapons, One-Handed or Two-Handed; require Strength and Dexterity.

keywords.name: Bows
keywords.definition: Two-Handed ranged weapons requiring Dexterity; allow a Quiver in the off hand.

keywords.name: Daggers
keywords.definition: One-Handed Melee weapons requiring Dexterity and Intelligence; for ambushing or debilitating enemies.

keywords.name: Staves
keywords.definition: Two-Handed spellcasting weapons requiring Intelligence; cannot be used to Attack.

keywords.name: Claws
keywords.definition: One-Handed Melee weapons requiring Dexterity; can be Dual Wielded with another Claw; attacks are fast and cause Bleeding.

keywords.name: Talismans
keywords.definition: Two-Handed Melee weapons requiring Strength and Intelligence; shapeshift you into a form and grant a basic Attack.

keywords.name: Shields
keywords.definition: Off-hand defensive items usually granting Armour; passive chance to Block plus an active Block or Parry skill.

keywords.name: Armoured Shields
keywords.definition: Any Shield that grants Armour, i.e. every type except Bucklers.

keywords.name: Bucklers
keywords.definition: Shields granting no Armour; can Parry enemy skills instead of being raised to Block.

keywords.name: Foci
keywords.definition: Off-hand Intelligence armour that can grant significant Energy Shield and spell bonuses.

keywords.name: Quarterstaves
keywords.definition: Two-Handed Melee weapons requiring Dexterity and Intelligence; focused on high mobility.

keywords.name: Spears
keywords.definition: One-Handed Melee weapons requiring Strength and Dexterity; cannot be Dual Wielded; often thrown.

keywords.name: Crossbows
keywords.definition: Two-Handed ranged weapons requiring Strength and Dexterity; basic Attacks can be changed by Ammunition Skills.

keywords.name: Flails
keywords.definition: One-Handed Melee weapons requiring Strength and Intelligence; cannot be Dual Wielded.

keywords.name: Flasks
keywords.definition: Recover Life or Mana using charges; charges regained by killing enemies, at Checkpoints and at Wells.

keywords.name: Utility Flasks
keywords.definition: Flasks giving a timed buff or combat ability; can be bound to action buttons.

keywords.name: Quivers
keywords.definition: Off-hand items usable only with a Bow; provide bonuses to Bow Attacks.

keywords.name: Spirit
keywords.definition: Resource used to activate and maintain skills with permanent effects; managed in the Skills Panel.

keywords.name: One-Handed
keywords.definition: Weapons occupying only the main weapon slot; some types can be Dual Wielded.

keywords.name: Two-Handed
keywords.definition: Weapons occupying both weapon slots when equipped.

keywords.name: Allies
keywords.definition: Other players, Minions or entities fighting alongside you; you are not your own Ally.

keywords.name: Dual Wielding
keywords.definition: Using two Martial Weapons, one in each hand.

keywords.name: Minions
keywords.definition: Summoned Allies that fight alongside you; Persistent Minions reserve some Spirit.

keywords.name: Warcries
keywords.definition: Count enemy Power in their area and empower your subsequent Melee Attacks.

keywords.name: Curses
keywords.definition: Significantly Debuff affected targets; one Curse per target by default; 15%/30%/50% less effect on Magic/Rare/Unique.

keywords.name: Dark Whispers
keywords.definition: Each gives 4% increased Curse Magnitude (max 10); last 8 seconds; on expiry lose 3% of Life, Mana and Energy Shield each over 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Aftershocks
keywords.definition: Area damage bursts after an Attack's initial impact; usually the same damage; Attack damage only.

keywords.name: Elusive
keywords.definition: Buff granting increased Movement Speed and chance to avoid damage; effects fade over time.

keywords.name: Shocked Ground
keywords.definition: Shocks those standing in it; lasts 6 seconds by default.

keywords.name: Energy Shield Leech
keywords.definition: Recovers Energy Shield as a percentage of Hit damage over one second; same limits as Life Leech.

keywords.name: Unarmed
keywords.definition: You are Unarmed while you have no equipped Martial or Caster Weapon.

keywords.name: Unarmed Attacks
keywords.definition: Attacks performed while Unarmed that use base Unarmed Damage instead of a weapon's damage.

keywords.name: Unarmed Damage
keywords.definition: Base Physical Attack Hit damage: minimum roll 2, maximum 5 to 8 depending on alignment with Strength.

keywords.name: Orb Skills
keywords.definition: Create lasting effects at a location that damage enemies in an area.

keywords.name: Exposure
keywords.definition: Debuff lowering Elemental Resistances by 20% for 4 seconds by default; reduced on higher-Rarity enemies.

keywords.name: Energy
keywords.definition: Generated and consumed by some Meta Gem skills to trigger other effects based on use time.

keywords.name: Ice Crystals
keywords.definition: Destructible ice blocks dealing Cold damage in an area when destroyed; block smaller monsters.

keywords.name: Ice Crystal Shattering
keywords.definition: Freeze-consuming skills instantly shatter Ice Crystals, making them deal more damage in a larger area.

keywords.name: Returning
keywords.definition: Projectiles that travel back to their originator after their travel or a final target.

keywords.name: Phasing
keywords.definition: While Phasing you pass through enemies without being blocked by them.

keywords.name: Corpses
keywords.definition: Left by slain enemies and used or consumed by some skills; Unique monster corpses cannot be destroyed or consumed.

keywords.name: Charges
keywords.definition: Fuel many skills; Endurance, Frenzy and Power types; up to 3 of each by default; last 15 seconds.

keywords.name: Elemental Damage Types
keywords.definition: The three Elemental damage types: Fire, Cold and Lightning.

keywords.name: Wells
keywords.definition: Present in every Town; refill Flasks and restore Life and Mana when used.

keywords.name: Presence
keywords.definition: Area around your character, 4 metres radius by default, where effects such as many Auras apply.

keywords.name: Light Radius
keywords.definition: Distance illuminated in dark areas and the radius within which terrain and points of interest are revealed on the map.

keywords.name: Item Rarity
keywords.definition: Normal, Magic (up to 2 Modifiers), Rare (up to 6) or Unique; more powerful enemies drop rarer items.

keywords.name: Shatter
keywords.definition: Frozen enemies Shatter when killed, destroying their corpse.

keywords.name: Resistance Penetration
keywords.definition: Lowers the target's Resistance for calculating damage from your Hits, not below 0% by default; does not affect Ailments.

keywords.name: Armour Break
keywords.definition: Lowers a target's Armour; at 0 it is Fully Broken for 12 seconds (4 for players); non-players take 20% increased Physical from Hits.

keywords.name: Armour Break below 0
keywords.definition: Armour broken below 0 becomes negative, so enemies take more Physical damage; capped by base Armour.

keywords.name: Channelling
keywords.definition: Skills held down to gain power or continue for longer.

keywords.name: Remote Skills
keywords.definition: Skills performed by another entity such as a Totem, Trap or Clone; Minions are not Remote Skills.

keywords.name: Ancestral Boost
keywords.definition: Ancestrally Boosted Slam has 30% more damage and 25% increased area; Ancestrally Boosted Strike targets 2 additional Enemies; counts as Empowered.

keywords.name: Ancestral Boosted Spells
keywords.definition: Boosted Spells have 30% more damage and 25% increased area; Triggered Skills cannot be boosted.

keywords.name: Buffs
keywords.definition: Boost a stat for a duration or while a condition is met; same-type Buffs do not stack unless stated.

keywords.name: Debuffs
keywords.definition: Negative effects that deal damage or penalise stats; same-type Debuffs do not stack unless stated.

keywords.name: Persistent Skills
keywords.definition: Toggled in the Skills Panel and often reserve Spirit to stay active.

keywords.name: Effect Consumption
keywords.definition: Consuming enemy effects for a benefit; one Consumption at a time; target immune to that Debuff for 1 second.

keywords.name: Orb of Alteration
keywords.definition: Reforges a Magic item with new random modifiers.

keywords.name: Artificer's Orb
keywords.definition: Adds an Augment socket to a Martial Weapon or Armour.

keywords.name: Auras
keywords.definition: Apply Buffs to Allies or Debuffs to enemies within a radius of the Aura source.

keywords.name: Stormsurge
keywords.definition: Each grants 3% of damage gained as extra Lightning damage for 5 seconds; maximum 10.

keywords.name: Reviving Minions
keywords.definition: Heal after avoiding damage and automatically revive after a short delay when killed.

keywords.name: Quality
keywords.definition: Adds small bonuses to items by type, up to a default maximum of 20%.

keywords.name: Support Gems
keywords.definition: Socketed into Skill Gems to modify only that skill; limits on duplicates and per-category use apply.

keywords.name: Area of Effect Skills
keywords.definition: Effect applies to every target in the area rather than chosen targets.

keywords.name: Duration Skills
keywords.definition: Skills whose Duration can be modified.

keywords.name: Detonator Skills
keywords.definition: Make flammable gas, Oil, explosives and similar effects explode on contact.

keywords.name: Nova Skills
keywords.definition: Take effect in a circular area around their user.

keywords.name: Triggered Skills
keywords.definition: Occur immediately without attack or cast time, usually targeting the trigger's cause; channelled skills cannot be Triggered.

keywords.name: Herald Skills
keywords.definition: Persistent Buffs granting powerful effects when enemies are killed.

keywords.name: Recoup
keywords.definition: Recovers a stated resource equal to a percentage of damage taken from Hits, over 8 seconds.

keywords.name: Thorns
keywords.definition: Hit damage you deal when enemies hit you in melee; not Attack or Spell damage.

keywords.name: Ignited Ground
keywords.definition: Repeatedly inflicts Flammability on standing enemies, Igniting them at 50%; 4 seconds and 2 metres radius by default.

keywords.name: Critical Weakness
keywords.definition: Hits against affected targets gain +0.5% Critical Hit Chance per stack, up to 20 stacks, each lasting 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Elemental Ground Surfaces
keywords.definition: Umbrella term for Shocked Ground, Chilled Ground and Ignited Ground.

keywords.name: Crossbow Ammunition Skills
keywords.definition: Replace your Crossbow's basic Attack with the indicated skill; most that Hit enemies have Knockback.

keywords.name: Monster Modifiers
keywords.definition: Magic monsters normally have one; Rare monsters up to 4 by default; each grants at least 100% increased Rarity of items dropped.

keywords.name: Unwavering Stance
keywords.definition: Cannot be Light Stunned; cannot Dodge Roll or Sprint.

keywords.name: Eldritch Battery
keywords.definition: Converts 100% of maximum Energy Shield to maximum Mana; doubles Mana costs.

keywords.name: Mind over Matter
keywords.definition: All damage is taken from Mana before Life; 50% less Mana Recovery Rate.

keywords.name: Blood Magic
keywords.definition: You have no Mana; skill Mana costs are converted to Life costs.

keywords.name: Giant's Blood
keywords.definition: Wield Two-Handed Axes, Maces and Swords in one hand; triple attribute requirements; inherent Life from Strength halved.

keywords.name: Vaal Pact
keywords.definition: 50% more Life leeched; Leech Life 67% less quickly; cannot recover Life other than from Leech.

keywords.name: Pain Attunement
keywords.definition: 30% less Critical Damage Bonus on Full Life; 30% more on Low Life.

keywords.name: Hex Master
keywords.definition: Can apply an additional Curse; double Activation Delay of Curses.

keywords.name: Glancing Blows
keywords.definition: Chance to Evade is Unlucky; chance to Deflect is Lucky.

keywords.name: Ancestral Bond
keywords.definition: Totem Limit doubled; no cost or Charge requirement to place Totems; Totems reserve 75 Spirit each.

keywords.name: Conduit
keywords.definition: If you would gain a Charge, Allies in your Presence gain that Charge instead.

keywords.name: Resolute Technique
keywords.definition: Accuracy Rating is doubled; never deal Critical Hits.

keywords.name: Whispers of Doom
keywords.definition: Can apply an additional Curse; double Activation Delay of Curses.

keywords.name: Avatar of Fire
keywords.definition: 75% of damage converted to Fire damage; deal no Non-Fire damage.

keywords.name: Scarred Faith
keywords.definition: 5% of Physical damage prevented recouped as Energy Shield per enemy Power; Energy Shield does not Recharge.

keywords.name: Lord of the Wilds
keywords.definition: Can equip a non-Unique Sceptre while wielding a Talisman; 50% less Spirit; Non-Minion skills have 50% less Reservation Efficiency.

keywords.name: Necromantic Talisman
keywords.definition: All bonuses from equipped Amulet apply to your Minions instead of you.

keywords.name: Hollow Palm Technique
keywords.definition: Can Attack as though using a Quarterstaff while both hand slots are empty; Unarmed Attacks change accordingly.

keywords.name: Chaos Inoculation
keywords.definition: Maximum Life is 1; immune to Chaos damage and Bleeding.

keywords.name: Martial Weapons
keywords.definition: Axes, Bows, Claws, Crossbows, Daggers, Flails, Maces, Quarterstaves, Spears, Swords and Talismans.

keywords.name: Sacrifice
keywords.definition: Loss of a resource (Life, Mana or Energy Shield) that does not count as taking damage; cannot reduce you below 1 Life.

keywords.name: Travel Skills
keywords.definition: Cover large distances without targeting; multiple Travel Skill cooldowns are shared.

keywords.name: Eternal Youth
keywords.definition: Life Recharges instead of Energy Shield; 50% less Life Recovery from Flasks.

keywords.name: Support Gem Requirements
keywords.definition: Each socketed Support Gem adds a cumulative Attribute requirement, generally 5 per gem; separate from skill and equipment requirements.

keywords.name: Buff/Debuff Magnitude
keywords.definition: The values of stats a Buff or Debuff applies; modifiers come from whoever applies it.

keywords.name: Buff/Debuff Effect
keywords.definition: Modifiers to Buff or Debuff effect usually come from the affected target.

keywords.name: Heartstopper
keywords.definition: 50% less damage over time if you started taking damage over time in the past second; 50% more if not.

keywords.name: Elemental Equilibrium
keywords.definition: Creates Lightning Infusion Remnants instead of Fire, Cold Infusion instead of Lightning, Fire Infusion instead of Cold.

keywords.name: Oasis
keywords.definition: Cannot use Charms; 30% more Recovery from Flasks.

keywords.name: Arcane Surge
keywords.definition: Grants 15% increased Cast Speed and 20% more Mana Regeneration Rate; lasts 4 seconds by default.

keywords.name: Invoke
keywords.definition: Invoked Skills are those Triggered by Invocation Skills.

keywords.name: Meta Gems
keywords.definition: Skill Gems that other Skill Gems can be socketed into; they use or Trigger those gems; cannot be socketed into other Meta Gems.

keywords.name: Final Strike
keywords.definition: The term used by skills for the last strike of their sequence.

keywords.name: Finality
keywords.definition: Buff granting 100% increased Critical Hit Chance with Final Strikes; Strikes skip to their Final Strike; no Combo while active.

keywords.name: Corrupted Blood
keywords.definition: Debuff dealing Physical damage over time; up to 10 per target; not Bleeding and not affected by Bleeding stats.

keywords.name: Aggravated Bleeding
keywords.definition: Aggravated Bleeding always treats the target as moving (100% extra damage); remains Aggravated until its duration expires.

keywords.name: Aggravated Ignite
keywords.definition: Ignite that has been Aggravated deals 100% extra damage; remains until its duration expires.

keywords.name: Allies Leech the same amount
keywords.definition: Allies' leech amount is not affected by their own modifiers, as your modifiers have already applied to it.

keywords.name: Non-Stacking Effects
keywords.definition: Does not stack; applying it again before the first expires refreshes the duration.

keywords.name: Mark
keywords.definition: Family of Debuffs applying powerful effects to a single enemy; each enemy can have one Mark; Marks Activate and are Consumed.

keywords.name: Life Recharge
keywords.definition: Lost Life recharges at 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds; further loss resets the delay.

keywords.name: Energy Shield Recharge
keywords.definition: Lost Energy Shield recharges at 12.5% per second after a base delay of 4 seconds; further loss resets the delay.

keywords.name: Energy Shield Protecting Mana
keywords.definition: Energy Shield only protects you from damage that would be dealt to Mana.

keywords.name: Onslaught
keywords.definition: Grants 20% increased Skill Speed and 10% increased movement speed; lasts 4 seconds unless specified.

keywords.name: Druidic Prowess
keywords.definition: Stacking Buff: 10% increased Skill Speed; Spell Hits grant 3 Rage per stack for 10 seconds; maximum 3 stacks.

keywords.name: Fear Incarnate
keywords.definition: Each grants 10% increased Culling Strike Threshold for 10 seconds; maximum 20.

keywords.name: Fear Overwhelming
keywords.definition: Each grants 5% increased Area of Effect for Attack Skills for 10 seconds; maximum 20.

keywords.name: Checkpoints
keywords.definition: Save progress; refill Life, Mana, Flasks and Charms; on death you may revive in Town or at the last Checkpoint.

keywords.name: Checkpoints in Maps
keywords.definition: Once all Checkpoints are activated and the Map is completed, remaining unfinished map content is revealed on the minimap.

keywords.name: Waypoints
keywords.definition: Save progress and allow quick travel between areas; reaching one refills Life, Mana, Flasks and Charms.

keywords.name: Elemental Ailment Threshold
keywords.definition: Higher threshold makes Elemental Ailments less likely and lowers Freeze and Electrocute buildup; default is half of Life.

keywords.name: Maximum Resistances
keywords.definition: Default maximum for Elemental or Chaos Resistance is 75%; cannot be raised above 90%.

keywords.name: Resonance
keywords.definition: Gain Power Charges instead of Frenzy, Frenzy instead of Endurance, Endurance instead of Power.

keywords.name: Sustained Skills
keywords.definition: Cause many Hits over time, each rolling Critical Hits independently.

keywords.name: Daze
keywords.definition: Some skills apply Daze on Hit; lasts 8 seconds; Dazed enemies take 50% more Stun Buildup.

keywords.name: Combo
keywords.definition: Counter on some Skills gained by Striking enemies; lost after a short time or on swapping Weapon Sets.

keywords.name: Minion Death and Killing Minions
keywords.definition: Expired or despawned Minions count as died, but effects that trigger on a Minion being Killed do not.

keywords.name: Surrounded
keywords.definition: You are Surrounded if there are at least 5 enemies within 3 metres of you; the number cannot be reduced below 1.

keywords.name: Reservation
keywords.definition: Sets aside part of a resource (usually Spirit) from other uses while active; does not change the maximum.

keywords.name: Low Infernal Flame
keywords.definition: You are on Low Infernal Flame at 35% or less of maximum Infernal Flame.

keywords.name: Bulwark
keywords.definition: Dodge Roll cannot Avoid Damage; take 30% less damage from Hits while Dodge Rolling.

keywords.name: Damage Conversion
keywords.definition: Converts damage to another type, which then scales with the new type's modifiers; two-step process; Damage over time cannot be converted.

keywords.name: Damage Gained as extra X
keywords.definition: Gained damage scales only with modifiers to the new type, not the source type (unless they match); Damage over time cannot benefit.

keywords.name: Tailwind
keywords.definition: Stacking Buff (max 10): 1% increased movement speed, 2% Skill Speed, 10% Evasion Rating, prevents 1% of Deflected Hit damage per stack; all lost on Hit.

keywords.name: Jade
keywords.definition: Stacking Buff (max 10) granting 1% additional Physical Damage Reduction per stack.

keywords.name: Concentration
keywords.definition: Enemies have less Cooldown Recovery Rate the lower their Concentration, down to 50% less at 0%.

keywords.name: Flame of Chayula
keywords.definition: Remnants: Red grants Life Leech of 20% max Life; Blue grants Mana Leech of 20% max Mana; Purple grants a stacking Chaos buff (7% of damage, 8 seconds, max 10 stacks).

keywords.name: Ancient Blooms
keywords.definition: Remnants granting 5 Charges: Vivid to all Charms, Primal to all Mana Flasks, Wild to all Life Flasks.

keywords.name: Red Flames of Chayula
keywords.definition: Leech 20% of maximum Life to you when collected.

keywords.name: Blue Flames of Chayula
keywords.definition: Leech 20% of maximum Mana to you when collected.

keywords.name: Small Passives
keywords.definition: Passive Skills that are not Notables, Keystones, Ascendancy Passive Skills or attribute-choice passives.

keywords.name: Valour
keywords.definition: Fuels Banner Skills; gained by killing with Attacks and by Banners near Unique enemies; maximum 50 per Banner by default.

keywords.name: Intimidate
keywords.definition: Debuff inflicting 10% increased damage taken and 10% reduced damage dealt.

keywords.name: Ballista Totems
keywords.definition: Totems that use Projectile Attacks.

keywords.name: Soul Core
keywords.definition: Vaal artifacts that function as Augments.

keywords.name: Abyssal Eye
keywords.definition: Artifacts recovered from Abyssals that function as Augments.

keywords.name: Rune
keywords.definition: Augments of Kalguuran origin.

keywords.name: Idol
keywords.definition: Augments fashioned by the Azmeri.

keywords.name: Honour
keywords.definition: Trial of the Sekhemas resource; a share of damage taken is removed from it; reaching zero fails the Trial.

keywords.name: Lightning Ailments
keywords.definition: Shock and Electrocute.

keywords.name: Added Skill Use Time
keywords.definition: Fixed extra use time that skill use speed stats do not modify.

keywords.name: Covered in Oil
keywords.definition: Oiled enemies are slowed, gain Exposure and take 200% more Flammability Magnitude; Ignite removes the Oil.

keywords.name: Oil Ground
keywords.definition: Enemies standing in Oil are slowed and gain Exposure; fire can Ignite the Oil.

keywords.name: Str
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (attribute).

keywords.name: Dex
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (attribute).

keywords.name: Int
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (attribute).

keywords.name: Str/Dex
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (hybrid attribute).

keywords.name: Str/Int
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (hybrid attribute).

keywords.name: Dex/Int
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (hybrid attribute).

keywords.name: Str/Dex/Int
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (triple attribute).

keywords.name: Two-Hander
keywords.definition: [DNT] placeholder entry (weapon category).

keywords.name: Stat Totals
keywords.definition: The final value of a stat after all calculations; modifiers to the total apply last.

keywords.name: Adding to Stat Totals
keywords.definition: Flat additions to a stat total occur after all other calculations, so percentage modifiers do not apply.

keywords.name: Charms
keywords.definition: Equippable trinkets that trigger defensive effects using charges, regained by killing monsters (half their Power); maximum 3 slots.

keywords.name: Zealot's Oath
keywords.definition: Excess Life Recovery from Regeneration goes to Energy Shield instead; Energy Shield does not Recharge.

keywords.name: Unbound Fury
keywords.definition: Chilling, Shocking or Igniting Enemies grants 1; Freezing or Electrocuting grants 6.

keywords.name: Stat Conversion
keywords.definition: Converting stat A to B applies A's base value to B; the converted part scales only with B's percentage modifiers.

keywords.name: Life Loss
keywords.definition: Not damage; cannot be mitigated or absorbed by Energy Shield; can still kill you.

keywords.name: Gaining Stats from other Stats
keywords.definition: Gaining a percentage of stat A as stat B uses A's base value and scales only with B's percentage modifiers.

keywords.name: Overflow
keywords.definition: Recovery exceeding the maximum can reach up to 1.5 times that maximum.

keywords.name: Minion Commands
keywords.definition: Certain Minions can be told to carry out actions through Command skills.

keywords.name: Difficulty
keywords.definition: Raises monster damage and life and improves drops; no additional effect above 4.

keywords.name: Revival Availability
keywords.definition: Limits deaths in endgame areas; boss deaths may respawn all players; Waystone modifiers can reduce revivals.

keywords.name: Map Boss
keywords.definition: Unique endgame boss with special mechanics; defeating it completes the Map.

keywords.name: Powerful Map Boss
keywords.definition: Harder Map Boss that drops better rewards and often Waystones one Tier higher.

keywords.name: Empowerment
keywords.definition: Upgrades a Map Boss into a Powerful Map Boss.

keywords.name: Waking Nightmare
keywords.definition: Debuff: 10% increased damage taken and 10% reduced Light Radius per stack for 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Toughness
keywords.definition: Each 100% of Toughness halves damage taken by a monster; negative Toughness increases damage taken.

keywords.name: Spreading Ailments
keywords.definition: Spreading inflicts a matching Ailment on another target from the same source; never back to the same target twice.

keywords.name: Dance with Death
keywords.definition: 25% more Skill Speed while Off Hand is empty and a One-Handed Martial Weapon is in the Main Hand.

keywords.name: Damage Contributing to Ailments
keywords.definition: Lets other damage types count toward specific Ailments' calculations.

keywords.name: Weapon Set Passive Skill Points
keywords.definition: Passive points allocated separately in each Weapon Set's Passive Tree.

keywords.name: Runic Inscriptions
keywords.definition: Created by ground-area Skills; Support Gems and Unique Items can interact with them.

keywords.name: Runic Bindings
keywords.definition: Each gives 10% reduced Spell Damage and 2% reduced skill cost Efficiency; up to 10; last 10 seconds; cannot be gained while Shapeshifted.

keywords.name: Unbound Potential
keywords.definition: Each gives 20% increased Damage, 10% increased Armour and 10% increased Energy Shield; up to 10; lose one every 5 seconds.

keywords.name: Offering Skills
keywords.definition: Target active Skeleton Minions to create Offering Spikes that grant Buffs.

keywords.name: Payoff Skills
keywords.definition: Gain extra effects when hitting enemies with specific Debuffs, often Consuming them.

keywords.name: Grenade Skills
keywords.definition: Crossbow-only skills with cooldowns; generally high damage or powerful utility; fuse duration.

keywords.name: Stun Recovery
keywords.definition: Increases how quickly you recover from being Stunned.

keywords.name: Grasping Vines
keywords.definition: Stacking Debuff slowing movement by 8% per stack; moving gradually removes stacks.

keywords.name: Enraged
keywords.definition: Buff granting 25% Toughness and 25% increased damage.

keywords.name: Volatiles
keywords.definition: Homing orbs that move toward targets and explode after a duration or on close approach.

keywords.name: Petrify
keywords.definition: Debuff turning targets to stone, unable to move or act.

keywords.name: Explosive Rhythm
keywords.definition: Each Buff grants 10% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate to Grenade Skills.

keywords.name: Explosive Fervour
keywords.definition: Buff granting 15% increased Attack Speed per different Grenade used Recently; Grenades ignore cooldown and explode on any impact.

keywords.name: Augment
keywords.definition: Items placed into Augment sockets; can be replaced but not removed by normal means.

keywords.name: Black Scythe Training
keywords.definition: Gain no inherent Strength bonus; 1% increased Energy Shield per 2 Strength.

keywords.name: Circular Teachings
keywords.definition: Gain no inherent Dexterity bonus; 1% increased Armour per 2 Dexterity.

keywords.name: Knightly Tenets
keywords.definition: Gain no inherent Intelligence bonus; 1% increased Evasion Rating per 2 Intelligence.

keywords.name: Sacred Water
keywords.definition: Trial of the Sekhemas resource used to buy Boons and venerate Maraketh Shrines.

keywords.name: Boons
keywords.definition: Positive Trial effects, Minor or Major.

keywords.name: Afflictions
keywords.definition: Negative Trial effects, Minor or Major.

keywords.name: Enfeeble
keywords.definition: Curse reducing damage dealt by 10% against unique targets and 20% against others by default.

keywords.name: Binding Chains
keywords.definition: Stacking Debuff slowing movement speed by 8% per stack.

keywords.name: Trial of the Sekhema Keys
keywords.definition: Bronze, Silver and Gold keys that open the Trial's caches.

keywords.name: Relics
keywords.definition: Items placed on the Relic Altar before a Trial to influence it; they persist between Trials.

keywords.name: Slow Magnitude Modifier
keywords.definition: Modifier scaling only the slow portion of a Debuff's Magnitude.

keywords.name: High Infernal Flame
keywords.definition: You are on High Infernal Flame at 65% or more of maximum Infernal Flame.

keywords.name: Purple Flame of Chayula
keywords.definition: Stacking Buff granting 7% of damage as extra Chaos damage; up to 10 stacks.

keywords.name: Skill Speed
keywords.definition: Speeds all Skills; stacks additively with Attack, Cast, Warcry and similar speeds.

keywords.name: Wildwood Wisp
keywords.definition: Grants 30% increased Tribute Gained to Players within 3 metres.

keywords.name: Close Range
keywords.definition: Anywhere within 2 metres of your character; normal Melee Attacks are in Close Range.

keywords.name: Unleash
keywords.definition: Spells accumulate Seals that let them reoccur when cast; limit of 2 Seals per Spell.

keywords.name: Link Skills
keywords.definition: Skills that link you to Allies to provide Buffs while within a certain distance.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.definition: Buff absorbing damage before Life or Energy Shield until it expires or is depleted; only one at a time; maximum 200% of max Life.

keywords.name: Delirium
keywords.definition: Delirium Mirror unleashes a rolling fog; monsters gain Delirium Modifiers; Rare or Unique monsters may manifest Delirium Demons; Fractured Mirrors may appear.

keywords.name: Expedition
keywords.definition: Ancient Kalguuran burial sites with Verisium Remnants and dangers buried beneath the ground; opened with explosives.

keywords.name: Verisium Remnant
keywords.definition: Fragments of stars with runes inscribed; craft rewards by fighting waves of Verisium-infused monsters.

keywords.name: Grand Expedition
keywords.definition: Larger Expedition with many more explosives and special Remnants; found only in Ocean Biomes revealed by Logbooks.

keywords.name: Breach
keywords.definition: Tears letting invaders from another world into ours; Unstable Breaches close by killing monsters; Breach Hives need Ailith.

keywords.name: Ritual
keywords.definition: Ritual Altars absorb slain monsters; activating resurrects them; defeating them earns Tribute for Favours.

keywords.name: Irradiated
keywords.definition: Area has +1 to Monster Level.

keywords.name: Abyss
keywords.definition: Pit with fissures; monsters near it are weakened; closing it spawns Abyssal monsters; may lead to Abyssal Depths.

keywords.name: Tablets
keywords.definition: Special items used in the Map Device to add more Endgame Mechanics to Maps.

keywords.name: Waystones
keywords.definition: Items used to travel to Maps on the Atlas; higher tiers are harder and drop higher-level items.

keywords.name: Essence
keywords.definition: Essence monsters trapped in crystallised corruption; breaking them free yields the Essence used to modify equipment.

keywords.name: Shrine
keywords.definition: Precursor Artifacts that empower monsters within their Presence; defeat the worshipping monsters to gain the power.

keywords.name: Strongbox
keywords.definition: Locked chests whose unlocking unleashes Packs of monsters that must be defeated for the items.

keywords.name: Precursor Towers
keywords.definition: Ancient structures on the Atlas; complete by activating the Precursor Beacon after defeating the Map Boss.

keywords.name: Fracturing Mirrors
keywords.definition: Structures in Delirium Fog that shatter when approached, spawning Delirium monsters.

keywords.name: Fracturing Mirror Shards
keywords.definition: Fracturing Mirror types found at set depths in Delirium Fog with varied effects (Escalation, Deceptive, Capricious).

keywords.name: Acrobatics
keywords.definition: Can Evade all Hits; 75% less Evasion Rating.

keywords.name: Basic Jewel
keywords.definition: Rubies, Emeralds, Sapphires and Diamonds; do not affect nodes in a radius.

keywords.name: The Realmgate
keywords.definition: Vaal Technology allowing use of Atlas mechanic keys to access deadly areas.

keywords.name: The Reliquary Vault
keywords.definition: A Vaal Vault accessed using Reliquary Keys found across the Atlas.

keywords.name: Corruption
keywords.definition: Contains Corruption, which may add a modifier to the area; corrupted areas cause slain monsters to Coalesce Corruption.

keywords.name: Unique Map
keywords.definition: Contains a Unique Map layout with possible specialised rewards; cannot gain additional content.

keywords.name: Hideout
keywords.definition: Can be fully cleared to unlock it for personal use; all monsters are at least Magic.

keywords.name: Wandering Trader
keywords.definition: Contains a Wandering Trader who may offer powerful rewards.

keywords.name: Citadel
keywords.definition: Three types (Copper, Iron, Stone) in different cities; complete one of each to access The Burning Monolith.

keywords.name: Copper Citadel
keywords.definition: Endgame area accessed with a Tier 15+ Waystone; its boss drops a Faded Crisis Fragment.

keywords.name: Iron Citadel
keywords.definition: Endgame area accessed with a Tier 15+ Waystone; its boss drops an Ancient Crisis Fragment.

keywords.name: Stone Citadel
keywords.definition: Endgame area accessed with a Tier 15+ Waystone; its boss drops a Weathered Crisis Fragment.

keywords.name: The Burning Monolith
keywords.definition: Houses the most dangerous foe in Wraeclast; requires three Crisis Fragments.

keywords.name: Map Node
keywords.definition: Represents a Map accessed with a Waystone; failed Maps can be retried without extra content and cannot use Tablets.

keywords.name: Cooldown Recovery Rate
keywords.definition: Speeds Skill cooldown restoration (100% increased halves cooldowns); affects nothing except Skill cooldowns.

keywords.name: Jewels
keywords.definition: Socketed into Jewel Sockets on the Passive Skill Tree for bonuses; some modify nearby passives.

keywords.name: Iron Grip
keywords.definition: Gain no inherent Strength bonus; 1% increased Projectile Attack damage per 2 Strength.

keywords.name: Iron Will
keywords.definition: Gain no inherent Strength bonus; 1% increased Spell damage per 2 Strength.

keywords.name: Soul Eater
keywords.definition: Eat Souls of enemies that die in your Presence; each grants 1% increased Skill Speed; up to 50.

keywords.name: Eaten Souls
keywords.definition: Each Soul grants 1% increased Skill Speed; up to 50; one lost every 0.5 seconds without eating one in the past 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Leech
keywords.definition: Recovers Life, Mana, Energy Shield or Rage over one second, based on Hit damage; one instance per resource at a time.

keywords.name: Historic Jewels
keywords.definition: You can only have one Historic Jewel socketed.

keywords.name: Catalysts
keywords.definition: Breach-exclusive currency adding Quality to Jewellery or Jewels.

keywords.name: Omens
keywords.definition: Currency enabling exclusive meta-crafting effects.

keywords.name: An Audience With The King
keywords.definition: Ritual drop allowing access to the Crux of Nothingness via the Realmgate.

keywords.name: Liquid Emotions
keywords.definition: Delirium-exclusive currency that instils an amulet with a Notable Passive Skill.

keywords.name: Ancient Liquid Emotions
keywords.definition: Liquid Emotion applying specific modifiers to Time-Lost Jewels.

keywords.name: Corrupted Items
keywords.definition: Items corrupted by a Vaal Orb with unpredictable changes; most crafting cannot be used; no penalty for using them.

keywords.name: Mirrored Items
keywords.definition: Copies of an item made with a Mirror of Kalandra; most crafting cannot be used.

keywords.name: Hexproof
keywords.definition: You are Unaffected by Curses.

keywords.name: Runic Monsters
keywords.definition: Powerful monsters encountered in Expeditions, commonly found using explosives on larger markers.

keywords.name: Coalesced Corruption
keywords.definition: Monsters slain close together have a chance to merge and manifest powerful Monsters.

keywords.name: Perfect Timing
keywords.definition: Certain Channelling skills have extra effects if released within a timing window.

keywords.name: Limit
keywords.definition: Certain skills can only have a limited number of effects active; a new one removes the oldest.

keywords.name: Monster Soul Eater
keywords.definition: Gains 1% increased Skill Speed and 1% less damage taken per Soul eaten, stacking up to 50.

keywords.name: Remnants
keywords.definition: Lingering objects created by player Skills; walking over one collects it for a bonus.

keywords.name: Ascendancy Points
keywords.definition: Allocated in the Ascendancy Skill Tree once you choose an Ascendancy; changing requires completing an Ascension Trial and an Ascendancy Altar interaction.

keywords.name: Honour Resistance
keywords.definition: You lose this much less Honour; capped at 75% by default and cannot be higher than 90%.

keywords.name: Stage-Gaining Skills
keywords.definition: Skills gain Stages passively or when attacking or casting them; Stages do not carry over between areas.

keywords.name: Primed for Pin
keywords.definition: Normal enemies Primed at 40% Pin buildup; Magic 50%, Rare 60%, Unique 70%.

keywords.name: Elemental Surges
keywords.definition: Consumed by non-Melee Projectile Attacks to make their Projectiles trigger a Surging Blast; maximum 6 of each type; last 15 seconds.

keywords.name: Chaos Surge
keywords.definition: Behaves like Elemental Surges but causes a Chaos blast.

keywords.name: Banner Skills
keywords.definition: Generate Glory when attacking monsters while active; a full Banner can be placed to create buffing areas; normally one Banner at a time.

keywords.name: Conditional Usage
keywords.definition: Skills requiring a condition before use, such as recent kills or distance moved.

keywords.name: Whirlwinds
keywords.definition: Blind and Slow enemies inside; collapse when the creator crosses the edge, dealing Melee damage and knockback.

keywords.name: Volatility
keywords.definition: Explodes after 4 seconds dealing 100 Physical damage per stack; grants Volatile Power (1% of damage as Chaos); max 200 stacks.

keywords.name: Bloodstained
keywords.definition: Bleeding enemies build the Bloodstained Debuff (after 6 seconds of Bleeding); builds 100% faster if the enemy is moving or Bleeding is Aggravated.

keywords.name: Revealing Weaknesses
keywords.definition: Highlighted segments on enemy Life bars totalling 45% of max Life; an enemy whose current Life is in one has an Open Weakness.

keywords.name: Affinity
keywords.definition: Fire, Cold and Lightning buffs from the Trinity skill; maximum 100 each; lose 10 per second after 8 seconds without gaining that type.

keywords.name: Incision
keywords.definition: Debuff raising the chance for Hits to inflict Bleeding by 10% per stack (max 10); all stacks cleared when Bleeding is inflicted.

keywords.name: Retaliate with Thorns
keywords.definition: Your inherent ability to deal Thorns damage to enemies that Hit you.

keywords.name: Companions
keywords.definition: Reviving Minions that are more complex and powerful; by default one of each type at a time.

keywords.name: Monster Category
keywords.definition: Every monster has one category: Humanoid, Beast, Undead, Construct, Demon or Eldritch.

keywords.name: Hobble
keywords.definition: Lowers a target's Evasion; at 0 they are fully Hobbled for 12 seconds; players Hobble 3x vs Normal and 2x vs Magic.

keywords.name: Hazards
keywords.definition: Objects created in the world that are destroyed when traversed by an enemy, dealing damage or applying an effect.

keywords.name: Unholy Might
keywords.definition: Buff granting 30% of all damage as extra Chaos damage.

keywords.name: Impale
keywords.definition: Debuff storing 30% of a Physical Hit's pre-mitigation damage, added to later Attack Hits; up to 60 Impales per target.

keywords.name: Blood Loss
keywords.definition: All Physical damage over time taken by a target, including Bleeding, accumulates as Blood Loss.

keywords.name: Perfection Buff
keywords.definition: Up to 4 stacks of 5% more damage, lasting 10 seconds; failing a Perfect Timing removes all stacks.

keywords.name: Killing Blow
keywords.definition: Hit damage that reduces a target to zero Life; damage over time cannot cause one.

keywords.name: Bifurcated Critical Hits
keywords.definition: Weapon rolls Critical Hit chance twice; either success is a Critical Hit; both successes apply the Critical Damage Bonus twice.

keywords.name: Pre-mitigation Damage
keywords.definition: Hit damage after your modifiers but before the target's mitigation such as Armour, Resistances or Blocking.

keywords.name: Easy Target
keywords.definition: Debuff making the next Projectile Attack hit against the target deal increased damage, then being consumed.

keywords.name: Expected Knockback
keywords.definition: The distance a target would be Knocked Back were nothing impeding it.

keywords.name: Rogue Exile
keywords.definition: Dangerous wandering foes with your kind of skills and gear; defeating them drops their full equipment; if they defeat you they portal away.

keywords.name: Azmeri Spirit
keywords.definition: Wisp-like spirits of Azmeri Animal Guardians; Normal or Magic monsters become Spirit-Influenced, Rare or Unique become Possessed.

keywords.name: Possessed
keywords.definition: Rare or Unique monster empowered by an Azmeri Spirit; summons spiritual animals; more rewarding after more Spirit-Influenced kills.

keywords.name: Spirit-Influenced
keywords.definition: Normal or Magic monster passed through by an Azmeri Spirit; defeating it makes the later Possessed monster more rewarding.

keywords.name: Extra Content
keywords.definition: Random extras in Maps: Shrines, Strongboxes, Essences, Rogue Exiles, Azmeri Spirits and Summoning Circles.

keywords.name: Seeking Shrine
keywords.definition: Grants increased Rarity of Items Found.

keywords.name: Enlightening Shrine
keywords.definition: Grants increased Experience.

keywords.name: Gloom Shrine
keywords.definition: Converts damage to extra Chaos; slain enemies can explode with Chaos damage based on their maximum Life.

keywords.name: Greed Shrine
keywords.definition: Converts item drops to Gold and increases monsters' Gold drops.

keywords.name: Cartographer's Strongbox
keywords.definition: Strongbox that drops Waystones.

keywords.name: Researcher's Strongbox
keywords.definition: Strongbox that drops Currency items.

keywords.name: Ornate Strongbox
keywords.definition: Strongbox with improved dropped Item Rarity.

keywords.name: Basic Strongbox
keywords.definition: Strongbox named simply "Strongbox" that drops random items.

keywords.name: Effective Chance
keywords.definition: The real chance of a result after roll-manipulating effects (e.g. Lucky: 20% becomes 36%) or forced outcomes are applied.

keywords.name: Crimson Assault
keywords.definition: Your inflicted Bleeding is Aggravated, has a base 1 second duration and 50% more Magnitude.

keywords.name: Equipped
keywords.definition: Weapon, Armour, Belt and Jewellery in Inventory equipment slots; Flasks, Skill Gems and Jewels are never Equipped.

keywords.name: Jewellery
keywords.definition: Amulets and Rings.

keywords.name: Equipment
keywords.definition: Items that can be Equipped.

keywords.name: Only Minimum or Maximum Damage
keywords.definition: Hits roll only the minimum or maximum damage, 50% each, separately for each damage type.

keywords.name: Trusted Kinship
keywords.definition: Allows two Companions of different types; 30% more Reservation Efficiency for Companion skills; 20% less for non-Companion skills.

keywords.name: Damage Absorption
keywords.definition: Effects including Guard, Encased in Jade and Sorcery Ward.

keywords.name: Parry
keywords.definition: Skill from Bucklers, Targes and dual-wielded Swords that Blocks an enemy Hit and retaliates, inflicting Parried.

keywords.name: Parried
keywords.definition: Debuff from Parry: Parried enemies take more Attack damage and cannot Evade Attacks for a duration.

keywords.name: Everlasting Sacrifice
keywords.definition: At full Energy Shield, sacrifice all of it for +5% to all Maximum Resistances for 4 seconds.

keywords.name: Aggravating any Bleeding
keywords.definition: Triggers when a weapon Hit directly Aggravates at least one Bleeding Debuff on the target.

keywords.name: Detonation Time
keywords.definition: Time after which skills with it detonate; duration modifiers do not affect it.

keywords.name: Waystone Tier Progression
keywords.definition: Only the final Powerful Map Boss can drop a Waystone of higher tier than the Map; chance diminishes at higher tiers.

keywords.name: Map Objective Waystone Drops
keywords.definition: The final Rare monster slain in a Map can drop a Waystone equal to the Map's tier.

keywords.name: Corrupted Nexus
keywords.definition: A source of immense corruption guarded by a powerful Corrupted Boss.

keywords.name: Corrupted Boss
keywords.definition: Guards a Corrupted Nexus; defeat it to cleanse the Nexus.

keywords.name: Retaliate against all Hits
keywords.definition: Lets Thorns retaliate against any Hit type, not only Melee; never against enemy Thorns damage.

keywords.name: Take Mana Costs as Damage
keywords.definition: Upfront Mana costs are taken as a single Hit; per-second costs are taken as damage over time.

keywords.name: Upfront Costs
keywords.definition: A cost paid as a fixed amount rather than a per-second rate.

keywords.name: Account Bound
keywords.definition: Cannot be traded to other players; can be shared between your own characters.

keywords.name: Essence of Delirium
keywords.definition: Monsters empowered by it periodically summon demons from behind the Delirium Mirror.

keywords.name: Cleansed
keywords.definition: Corruption-cleansed areas may gain an additional modifier and contain twisted monsters.

keywords.name: Delirious Players
keywords.definition: Players assaulted by illusions; higher Delirium makes monsters stronger and improves their drops.

keywords.name: Chances in excess of 100%
keywords.definition: Chances above 100% act as 100% unless an effect scales with the excess.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Owl
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 60% increased Energy Shield, 80% increased Damage, 20% of Damage as extra Cold; periodic Owl cold tornadoes.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Serpent
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: all Hit damage contributes to Poison, always Poison on Hit, 80% increased Damage; Snakes strike enemies.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Primate
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: all Hit damage contributes to Chill, 60% increased Freeze Buildup, 80% increased Damage; periodic Primate groups.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Bear
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 20% increased Maximum Life, 60% increased Stun Threshold and Stun Buildup, 20% reduced damage taken; Bear slams.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Boar
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 20% of Damage as extra Fire, always inflict Bleeding on Hit, 20% reduced damage taken; exploding Boars.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Ox
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 50% reduced Slowing Potency on you, 60% increased Elemental Ailment Threshold and Armour, 20% reduced damage taken; Ox stampedes.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Wolf
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 10% increased Skill Speed, 5% increased Movement Speed, Armour Break equal to 10% of Hit damage; Wolf maiming dashes.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Stag
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: +30% to all Elemental Resistances, 30% increased Skill Speed, 15% increased Movement Speed, 20% of Damage as extra Lightning; Stag lightning bolts.

keywords.name: Spirit Of The Cat
keywords.definition: Possessing Spirit: 60% increased Evasion Rating, 100% increased Critical Hit chance, 30% increased Skill Speed, 15% increased Movement Speed; Cat flurries.

keywords.name: Vulnerability
keywords.definition: Curse that removes 191 Armour by default.

keywords.name: Despair
keywords.definition: Curse lowering Chaos Resistance by 25% by default.

keywords.name: Temporal Chains
keywords.definition: Curse slowing those affected by 26% by default; other effects on them expire more slowly.

keywords.name: Resisted by Other Value
keywords.definition: Hits ignore the target's actual Resistance value and are mitigated by a specified value instead; Penetration does not apply to it.

keywords.name: Glory
keywords.definition: Resource spent on certain Skills; generated equal to the monster's Power, once per 0.5 seconds per monster; lost at 2 per second after 15 seconds without gaining.

keywords.name: Mounting Greed
keywords.definition: Increased Rarity of Items on kill, up to 100%; decays over time; higher-Rarity monsters grant more.

keywords.name: Obelisk of Corruption
keywords.definition: Activates when approached; grants a 10 second Buff making enemies you kill explode for 10% of their life as Physical damage.

keywords.name: Obelisk of Cleansing
keywords.definition: Activates when approached; 10 second Buff granting 100% Item Rarity, 50% increased Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield, and 30% of Damage as extra Lightning.

keywords.name: Immured Fury
keywords.definition: Powerful monster that appears due to the Cleansing process; dangerous, with greatly increased rewards.

keywords.name: Fractured Modifiers
keywords.definition: A modifier permanently locked onto an item; cannot be removed or altered.

keywords.name: Weapon Sets
keywords.definition: Two independent Weapon Sets with their own dedicated Passive Skill Points; Skills use the active set or swap automatically.

keywords.name: Additional Projectiles
keywords.definition: Monster fires 4 additional Projectiles.

keywords.name: Increased Area of Effect
keywords.definition: Monster has 100% increased Area of Effect.

keywords.name: Breaks Armour
keywords.definition: Monster Breaks Armour equal to 1000% of Physical damage dealt.

keywords.name: Bombardier
keywords.definition: Monster periodically unleashes barrages of Fire projectiles.

keywords.name: Chaos Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has +50% to Chaos Resistance.

keywords.name: Cold Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has +50% to Cold Resistance and +10% to Maximum Cold Resistance.

keywords.name: Extra Crits
keywords.definition: Monster has 300% increased chance to Critically Hit.

keywords.name: Extra Chaos Damage
keywords.definition: Monster gains 40% of damage as extra Chaos damage.

keywords.name: Extra Cold Damage
keywords.definition: Monster gains 40% of damage as extra Cold damage.

keywords.name: Extra Fire Damage
keywords.definition: Monster gains 40% of damage as extra Fire damage.

keywords.name: Extra Lightning Damage
keywords.definition: Monster gains 40% of damage as extra Lightning damage.

keywords.name: Energy Shield Aura
keywords.definition: Aura granting Allies within 5 metres 20% of maximum Life as added Energy Shield.

keywords.name: Armoured
keywords.definition: Monster gains extra Armour based on its Strength.

keywords.name: Extra Energy Shield
keywords.definition: Monster gains 25% of maximum Life as added Energy Shield.

keywords.name: Evasive
keywords.definition: Monster gains extra Evasion based on its Dexterity.

keywords.name: Fire Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has +50% to Fire Resistance and +10% to Maximum Fire Resistance.

keywords.name: Conjures Flamewalls
keywords.definition: Monster creates circular walls of Fire that damage enemies standing in them.

keywords.name: Siphons Flask Charges
keywords.definition: Aura removing 3 Flask and Charm charges from enemies every 3 seconds within 3.6 metres.

keywords.name: Conjures Ice Prisons
keywords.definition: Monster creates circular walls of Ice around enemies.

keywords.name: Heals Allies and Suppresses Foe Recovery
keywords.definition: Nova reducing enemy Life and Energy Shield Recovery Rate by 60%; Allies Regenerate 5.5% of max Life per second for 4 seconds within 5 metres every 8 seconds.

keywords.name: Hinder Aura
keywords.definition: Aura that Hinders enemies within 3.6 metres.

keywords.name: Periodic Invulnerability Aura
keywords.definition: Nova making Allies within 5 metres invulnerable for 5 seconds every 12 seconds while the monster is alive.

keywords.name: Empowered Periodic Invulnerability Aura
keywords.definition: Nova making Allies within 5 metres invulnerable for 5 seconds every 12 seconds while the monster is alive.

keywords.name: Increased Life
keywords.definition: Monster has 50% increased Life.

keywords.name: Slow Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has 50% reduced Slowing Potency of Debuffs on it.

keywords.name: Increased Stun Threshold
keywords.definition: Monster cannot be Stunned.

keywords.name: Accurate
keywords.definition: Monster has 200% increased Accuracy Rating.

keywords.name: Hasted
keywords.definition: Monster has 30% increased Attack, Cast and Movement speed.

keywords.name: Haste Aura
keywords.definition: Aura granting Allies within 5 metres 20% increased Attack and Cast speed and 10% increased Movement speed.

keywords.name: Regenerates Life
keywords.definition: Monster regenerates 2% of maximum Life per second.

keywords.name: Lightning Mirage When Hit
keywords.definition: Monster creates a Mirage when Hit that moves toward enemies and explodes with Lightning damage.

keywords.name: Lightning Mirages When Hit
keywords.definition: Monster creates Mirages when Hit that move toward enemies and explode with Lightning damage.

keywords.name: Lightning Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has +50% to Lightning Resistance and +10% to Maximum Lightning Resistance.

keywords.name: Volatile Crystals
keywords.definition: Monster creates Volatile Crystals when Hit, which explode with Chaos damage on the monster's death.

keywords.name: Magma Barrier
keywords.definition: Monster creates a 90% damage absorption barrier that explodes with Fire damage after taking a certain amount.

keywords.name: Siphons Mana and Deals Lightning Damage
keywords.definition: Circular effect draining Mana and dealing Lightning damage over time to enemies near its edge.

keywords.name: Damage Taken From Minions First
keywords.definition: 50% of damage taken by the monster is taken from its Pack Minions instead.

keywords.name: Empowered
keywords.definition: Monster has 25% increased Damage and 50% increased Life.

keywords.name: Crit Resistant
keywords.definition: Hits against this Monster have 80% reduced Critical Damage Bonus.

keywords.name: Periodically Enrages
keywords.definition: Monster periodically Enrages: 30% increased Damage, 25% increased Skill and Movement Speed, 33% less damage taken for 5 seconds every 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Extra Physical Damage Aura
keywords.definition: Aura granting Allies within 5 metres 40% increased Physical damage.

keywords.name: Prevents Recovery Above 50%
keywords.definition: Aura Debuffing enemies within 4.2 metres so their Life and Energy Shield cannot recover past 50%.

keywords.name: Proximal Tangibility
keywords.definition: Monster cannot be damaged by enemies further than 3 metres away.

keywords.name: Elemental Resistance Aura
keywords.definition: Aura granting Allies within 5 metres +35% to all Elemental Resistances.

keywords.name: Empowered Reviving Minions
keywords.definition: Monster periodically revives Pack Minions with increased Life and Damage.

keywords.name: Trail of Lightning
keywords.definition: Monster leaves a trail of Shocked Ground as it moves.

keywords.name: Shroud Walker
keywords.definition: Monster periodically teleports to an enemy it can see, creating a Smoke Cloud where it leaves and arrives.

keywords.name: Powerful Minions
keywords.definition: Monster's Pack Minions have 25% increased Damage and 50% increased Life.

keywords.name: Stuns
keywords.definition: Monster has 100% increased Stun buildup.

keywords.name: Stun Resistant
keywords.definition: Monster has 250% increased Stun Threshold.

keywords.name: Temporal Bubble
keywords.definition: Aura Debuffing enemies within 3.2 metres: Slowing by 25%, making effects expire 40% slower and reducing Cooldown Recovery Rate by 60%.

keywords.name: Volatile Plants
keywords.definition: Monster periodically creates Volatile Plants, orbs that explode with Chaos damage near enemies.

keywords.name: Empowering Volatile Plants
keywords.definition: Monster periodically creates Powerful Volatile Plants that explode with Chaos damage near enemies.

keywords.name: Volatile Crag
keywords.definition: Monster periodically creates a Volatile Crag that moves toward enemies and explodes with Fire damage.

keywords.name: Empowering Volatile Crag
keywords.definition: Monster periodically creates a Powerful Volatile Crag that moves toward enemies and explodes with Fire damage.

keywords.name: Pack
keywords.definition: A Pack Monster or Minion naturally spawned in a Monster Pack; Pack Size modifiers can add an Additional Rare Monster.

keywords.name: Crescendo Arrows
keywords.definition: Chain 6 additional times, each Chain dealing 60% increased Damage.

keywords.name: Splinter Arrows
keywords.definition: Splintering Arrows Split towards 6 targets.

keywords.name: Reversing Arrows
keywords.definition: Pierce all targets and Return to you.

keywords.name: Diamond Arrows
keywords.definition: All Hits are Critical Hits with 60% increased Critical Damage Bonus.

keywords.name: Covetous Arrows
keywords.definition: Enemies killed drop items with 600% increased Rarity.

keywords.name: Blunt Arrows
keywords.definition: Cause 600% increased Stun Buildup.

keywords.name: Repeating Skills
keywords.definition: Skills that can Repeat, firing projectiles or effects multiple times in quick succession; each repeat makes the skill take 5% longer; Triggered, Instant and Channelling skills cannot Repeat.

keywords.name: Guided Meteoric Shrine
keywords.definition: "Meteors rain down around you when in range of enemies."

keywords.name: Guided Tempest Shrine
keywords.definition: Lightning bolts strike the ground around you when in range of enemies.

keywords.name: Guided Freezing Shrine
keywords.definition: Freezing shards fire around you in a spiral when in range of enemies.

keywords.name: Dreaming Gloom Shrine
keywords.definition: Slain enemies explode, dealing Chaos damage equal to a quarter of their maximum Life.

keywords.name: Abyssal Wasting
keywords.definition: Reduces Life Regeneration Rate by 50% for 6 seconds.

keywords.name: Ancient Augment
keywords.definition: Augments with powerful singular effects; only one of this type may be socketed at a time.

keywords.name: Equippable Armours
keywords.definition: Helmets, Body Armours, Gloves, Boots, Shields and Foci.

keywords.name: Caster Weapons
keywords.definition: Sceptres, Staves and Wands.

keywords.name: Spectral Fire
keywords.definition: Ignite damage on affected targets feeds the debuff; it explodes for all absorbed damage within 1.8 metres when it expires.

keywords.name: Sanctified Items
keywords.definition: Each modifier's value is multiplied by a random 78% to 122%; most crafting cannot be used on them.

keywords.name: Efficiency
keywords.definition: Divisor modifiers that make the modified stat smaller (or larger, if reduced); e.g. 50% increased Reservation Efficiency gives 67% of base Reservation.

keywords.name: Blackflame Covenant
keywords.definition: Converts 100% of Fire Spell damage to Chaos; Chaos from Fire Spells contributes to Flammability and Ignite magnitudes.

keywords.name: Ritual Cadence
keywords.definition: Invocation Skills Trigger Spells every 2 seconds; they cannot gain Energy while doing so; invoked Spells consume 50% less Energy.

keywords.name: Elemental Weakness
keywords.definition: Curse lowering Elemental Resistances by 30% for 20 seconds unless specified.

keywords.name: Debilitate
keywords.definition: Debuff: 20% reduced movement speed and 10% reduced damage dealt; lasts 1 second unless specified.

keywords.name: Support Gem Categories
keywords.definition: Every Support Gem is in one or more Categories; gems from the same Category cannot be socketed into the same skill.

keywords.name: Minimum Modifier Level
keywords.definition: Random Modifiers added are at least this level; currency with it cannot be used on items below that item level.

keywords.name: Maximum Item Level
keywords.definition: Currency cannot be used on items above this level.

keywords.name: Heat
keywords.definition: Gained from specific Crossbow Skills; beneficial or detrimental depending on the Skill.

keywords.name: Elemental Infusions
keywords.definition: Remnant-granted buffs lasting 20 seconds or until Consumed; up to 3 of each type by default.

keywords.name: Desecrated Modifiers
keywords.definition: Desecrating adds an Unrevealed Desecrated modifier revealed at the Well of Souls; items cannot be Desecrated twice.

keywords.name: Unstable Desecration
keywords.definition: Items that can be Desecrated with a Preserved Cranium, with an increasing chance of destruction each time.

keywords.name: Abyssal Modifiers
keywords.definition: Modifiers stolen by Abyssal Monsters that can be upgraded; rarely into Lichborn Modifiers.

keywords.name: Abyssal Depths
keywords.definition: Underground dungeon sometimes found after the final Abyss; all Rare monsters have an Abyssal Modifier; ends with a powerful Rare.

keywords.name: Marked for Death
keywords.definition: Debuff causing you to take 50% increased damage.

keywords.name: Lineage Supports
keywords.definition: Powerful Support Gems from maps or specific sources; only one copy of each may be socketed across all skills.

keywords.name: Naturally Spawning Monsters
keywords.definition: Monsters spawned on first entering an area; excludes those from Strongboxes or Expeditions.

keywords.name: Gruelling Madness
keywords.definition: First stack Slows movement by 15%; additional stacks raise Slowing Potency by 10%; maximum 10; one lost every 2 seconds without more.

keywords.name: Faerie Fire
keywords.definition: Each Debuff makes Hits gain 2% of damage as extra random Element damage; lasts 8 seconds; up to 10.

keywords.name: Runefather's Challenge
keywords.definition: Debuff raising the affected targets' Power by 5.

keywords.name: Runefather's Boast
keywords.definition: Buff granting +1 Armour, +1 Evasion and +1 Stun Threshold per stack; up to 10,000; lost on death or area change.

keywords.name: Union of Souls
keywords.definition: Pack monsters transfer their soul to another Pack monster on death, granting 6% Toughness and 2% increased damage.

keywords.name: Thaumaturgical Dynamism
keywords.definition: Passively generates a Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge every five seconds, based on the Attribute requirements of socketed Skills.

keywords.name: Armour Movement Penalties
keywords.definition: Reduced movement speed penalties for equipped Body Armours and Shields depending on their Attribute requirement.

keywords.name: Merging
