keywords.definition: Crossbow bolt fragments hitting the same target at once combine their damage into a single Hit.

keywords.name: Pacification
keywords.definition: Pacified enemies cannot deal damage.

keywords.name: Archon Buff
keywords.definition: Archons significantly augment a skill type; last 10 seconds by default; 20-second recovery period before another can be gained.

keywords.name: Ice Archon
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Cold Spell damage, converts Elemental Spell damage to Cold, 100% more Freeze buildup from Spells; removed by a non-instant Attack.

keywords.name: Flame Archon
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Fire Spell damage, converts Elemental Spell damage to Fire, Spells have 100% more Flammability Magnitude; removed by a non-instant Attack.

keywords.name: Lightning Archon
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Lightning Spell damage, converts Elemental Spell damage to Lightning, Spell Hits have 100% more Shock chance; removed by a non-instant Attack.

keywords.name: Elemental Archon
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Elemental Spell damage; Freeze, Flammability and Shock from Spells doubled; removed by a non-instant Attack.

keywords.name: Nature's Archon
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Plant damage, Plants have 100% chance to Overgrow, 200% more Plant Skill Effect Duration, +2 Limit for Plant Skills.

keywords.name: Archon of Undeath
keywords.definition: Grants 25% more Minion damage, 200% more Cooldown Recovery Rate for Command Skills, 100% more Limit for Temporary Minion Skills; revives Persistent Undead Minions.

keywords.name: Temporary Minion
keywords.definition: A Minion that does not revive after it dies.

keywords.name: Minion Reforming
keywords.definition: Revives Persistent Minions only when the "Minion Reforming" Buff timer ends while they are dead.

keywords.name: Gigantic
keywords.definition: Minions with 20% more Maximum Life, 20% more Damage and 20% increased size.

keywords.name: Mark of the Abyssal Lord
keywords.definition: Desecrating an item always removes this modifier, replacing it with a higher-tier Unrevealed Desecrated modifier.

keywords.name: Riven Armour
keywords.definition: Debuff storing 5% of a Hit's pre-mitigation Physical damage, adding that much extra Physical damage to later Attacks; cannot be Armour Broken further.

keywords.name: Molten Fissures
keywords.definition: Long-lasting fissures created by some Slams that can themselves be Slammed to cause Aftershocks.

keywords.name: Sands of Time
keywords.definition: Skill Speed oscillates from 60% down to 1% and Area of Effect from 1% up to 60% over 10-second cycles.

keywords.name: Unravelling
keywords.definition: Chaos damage randomly contributes to Freeze buildup, Flammability and Ignite, or Shock chance, changing every two seconds.

keywords.name: Embankment Auras
keywords.definition: Totems give players Auras: Artillery Ballista 20% Skill Speed; Siege Ballista 25% more damage vs Immobilised; Mortar Cannon 25% of damage as Fire; Shockwave Totem 30% AoE; Ancestral Warrior Totem 40% Glory generation; Dark Effigy 40% Damage over Time; Spell Totem 50% Critical Hit Chance.

keywords.name: Ice Fragments
keywords.definition: Cold damage objects created by Skills that Detonate in an area; only one can damage a single enemy per Skill use.

keywords.name: Fragment of Divinity
keywords.definition: Fragments consumed by certain Skills for extra effects; last 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Divinity
keywords.definition: Resource spent on Skills like Mana; regenerates at 25% per second.

keywords.name: Broken Stance
keywords.definition: Debuff storing 10% of a Hit's pre-mitigation Physical damage, adding it to later Hits; prevents re-Daze.

keywords.name: Umbral Souls
keywords.definition: Buffs from replacing Skeletal Minions: Warriors 15% Attack Damage, Snipers 15% Projectile Speed, Clerics 30% Energy Shield Recharge Rate, Arsonists 15% AoE, Storm Mages 25% Spell Damage, Frost Mages 35% max Energy Shield, Brutes 60% Stun buildup, Reavers 6% Skill Speed.

keywords.name: Deadly Map Boss
keywords.definition: Harder Powerful Map Bosses in specific Maps with better rewards; can drop items granting access to Pinnacle Bosses.

keywords.name: Pinnacle Boss
keywords.definition: Endgame bosses accessed via specific keys or mechanic interactions.

keywords.name: Invocation
keywords.definition: Persistent Skills that gain Energy and spend it to Trigger socketed Skills.

keywords.name: Sundered Armour
keywords.definition: Debuff on fully Broken Armour enemies adding 20% more Physical damage taken, stacking with the normal Fully Broken effect.

keywords.name: Isolated
keywords.definition: A target with none of its allies within 6 metres.

keywords.name: Overflowing Chalice
keywords.definition: Buff making Life and Mana Flasks gain 2 charges per second and provide 30% increased recovery.

keywords.name: Withering Ground
keywords.definition: Applies Withered every second to enemies standing in it.

keywords.name: Default Attack
keywords.definition: Innate Attack skills from Martial Weapons and the unarmed "Punch"; never have a cost.

keywords.name: Default Attack Damage
keywords.definition: Expected damage of a Default Attack, determined by Weapon damage and character level scaling.

keywords.name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
keywords.definition: Stacks up to 8 times, granting 5% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate per stack; each stack lasts 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Helbrym's Composure
keywords.definition: Stores damage taken; when it expires you gain Guard equal to 50% of the stored damage and Rage equal to 3%.

keywords.name: Connected Support Gems
keywords.definition: Two gems are Connected if one is socketed into the other or both into a third gem; includes Meta Skill connections.

keywords.name: Summoning Circle
keywords.definition: Activating it spawns a Boss; areas with several use runes to reactivate instead.

keywords.name: Adaptation
keywords.definition: Gained from taking Elemental damage; reduces future damage of that type; 3 at a time by default; no duration.

keywords.name: Bear Form
keywords.definition: Shapeshift granting Slams and Fire Attacks; +10 Armour per level; 30% of Armour applies to Elemental damage; an Endurance Charge per 15 Rage spent.

keywords.name: Werewolf Form
keywords.definition: Shapeshift that drops to all fours after moving for a short time, gaining 30% increased movement speed when not Sprinting.

keywords.name: Wyvern Form
keywords.definition: Shapeshift granting 50% increased Stun Threshold, 50% increased Elemental Ailment Threshold and 50% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge.

keywords.name: Plant Skills and Overgrowth
keywords.definition: Plants created by Plant Skills can be Overgrown to gain power, using a different Skill or effect.

keywords.name: Inevitable Critical Hits
keywords.definition: Hits that do not roll a Critical Hit re-roll until they succeed; 30% less Critical Damage Bonus per re-roll.

keywords.name: Monster Effectiveness
keywords.definition: For every 2% increased Effectiveness: 2% more Toughness, 1% more Experience and 1% more item quantity.

keywords.name: Primal Hunger
keywords.definition: 100% more Maximum Rage; regenerate 1 Rage per second per 4 Rage spent Recently; no Rage effect.

keywords.name: Unique Culture
keywords.definition: Unique items tied to certain cultures, indicated by an icon in their tooltip.

keywords.name: Wind Skills
keywords.definition: Gain additional interactions with other specified Skills, typically Fire Skills.

keywords.name: Paths Not Taken
keywords.definition: Reveals Oracle-only passive nodes after Ascending as an Oracle; The Unseen Path Ascendancy Notable allows allocating them.

keywords.name: Bonded Modifiers
keywords.definition: Some Rune and Idol modifiers are available only to players who allocated the Shaman's Wisdom of the Maji Ascendancy Notable.

keywords.name: Vaal Siphoner
keywords.definition: Requires a set number of kills; then a random modifier is downgraded in tier and the others improved.

keywords.name: Chance can Surpass 100%
keywords.definition: Each full 100% triggers the event once; the remainder is rolled normally (e.g. 215% occurs twice plus a 15% roll).

keywords.name: Maximum Quality
keywords.definition: The default maximum Quality is 20%.

keywords.name: Thorny Ground
keywords.definition: Deals Spell damage on creation, then damages enemies moving over it, no more than twice per second.

keywords.name: Splash Damage
keywords.definition: Strike Skills can deal Splash damage to enemies around the one hit; base radius 1.5 metres.

keywords.name: Activating Marks
keywords.definition: Marks have a condition that makes them Activate; when activated, they cause an extra effect and are Consumed.

keywords.name: Rerolling Critical Hit Chance
keywords.definition: Any mechanic rolling Critical Hit chance more than once for a single Hit (Lucky, Unlucky, Bifurcated, Inevitable); Sustained Skills' per-hit rolls are not rerolling.

keywords.name: Compounding Ignite
keywords.definition: Igniting an already-Ignited target removes the existing Ignite to boost the new one, multiplying Magnitude by the number of Ignites compounded.

keywords.name: Drenched
keywords.definition: Debuff making enemies easier to Shock and Freeze.

keywords.name: Storm Skills
keywords.definition: Long-duration weather-based Skills with special interactions.

keywords.name: Maximum
keywords.definition: The maximum value of a modifier is applied to the whole modifier, including the constant part.

keywords.name: Wildsurge Incantation
keywords.definition: Storm and Plant Spells deal 50% more damage, have 75% less duration and 50% less cost.

keywords.name: Energised Crystal
keywords.definition: Collected by energising Vaal Beacons; 6 are required to power the Temple Console.

keywords.name: Base Skill Attack Time
keywords.definition: Base time to perform an Attack Skill, from the weapon's Attacks per Second and the gem's Base Attack Speed percentage.

keywords.name: Temple Destabilisation
keywords.definition: Each Temple entry randomly Destabilises some rooms, removed on exit; completion destabilises more.

keywords.name: Restricted Room
keywords.definition: Rooms placed using Xipocado's Console in the Architect's Chamber.

keywords.name: Juatalotli's Medallion
keywords.definition: Prevents the next Destabilisation of a Room.

keywords.name: Hayoxi's Medallion
keywords.definition: Rerolls a Restricted Room in the Temple.

keywords.name: Quipolatl's Medallion
keywords.definition: Upgrades the Tier of a Room.

keywords.name: Uromoti's Medallion
keywords.definition: Allows placing a specific Room in the Temple.

keywords.name: Xopec's Medallion
keywords.definition: Increases Maximum Crystal Capacity by 6 (up to 60).

keywords.name: Azcapa's Medallion
keywords.definition: Increases Maximum Medallion Capacity by 1 (up to 6).

keywords.name: Estazunti's Medallion
keywords.definition: Allows an additional Restricted Room Card after defeating the Architect.

keywords.name: Puhuarte's Medallion
keywords.definition: Allows rerolling the Room Cards available for placement.

keywords.name: Zantipi's Medallion
keywords.definition: Adds one to the number of random Waystone Modifiers added to the Temple.

keywords.name: Power
keywords.definition: Provided to connected Paths by Generator rooms; Powered Paths provide Power to adjacent rooms.

keywords.name: Limb Modification
keywords.definition: Performed with a Transcension Device; replaces a body part with a modified version granting an extra stat; lost on resurrection.

keywords.name: Medallions
keywords.definition: Obtained from Atziri's Temple; used to modify the Temple in various ways.

keywords.name: Ailment Application
keywords.definition: Modifiers apply to Bleeding, Poison and Shock chance, and to Flammability, Freeze and Electrocution buildup.

keywords.name: Vaal Beacon
keywords.definition: Energising Vaal Beacons energises Crystals, allowing access to Atziri's Temple.

keywords.name: Fragmented Mirror
keywords.definition: Each Mirror offers a rare Ring or Amulet base type.

keywords.name: Soaring Ground
keywords.definition: Grants 30% increased Evasion Rating, 40% increased damage on Full Life, and Onslaught; 6 second base duration.

keywords.name: Shrine Worship
keywords.definition: Shrines are found with packs of monsters Worshipping them; other monsters affected by the Presence are not Worshippers.

keywords.name: Runic Ward
keywords.definition: Absorbs fatal damage instead of Life, leaving you at 1 Life; regenerates 5% per second; monsters with it cannot be Culled.

keywords.name: Monster Rarity
keywords.definition: Increases the chance for monsters to be Rare or Magic; also increases Monster Modifier Chance for Rare Monsters.

keywords.name: Item Armour
keywords.definition: Uses the exact Armour value listed on the item, including Quality and local modifiers.

keywords.name: Item Evasion
keywords.definition: Uses the exact Evasion value listed on the item, including Quality and local modifiers.

keywords.name: Item Energy Shield
keywords.definition: Uses the exact Energy Shield value listed on the item, including Quality and local modifiers.

keywords.name: Free Rerolls
keywords.definition: Ritual Free Rerolls allow rerolling Favours an additional time at no cost.

keywords.name: Monster Minions
keywords.definition: Monsters in a Rare Monster Pack; each receives one modifier from each Rare Monster in the Pack.

keywords.name: Rogue Exile Hunting Ground
keywords.definition: Contains 2 additional Rogue Exiles and 5 additional Packs of Rare Beasts.

keywords.name: Room Upgrades
keywords.definition: Temple rooms may have their tier upgraded up to a default maximum of tier 3.

keywords.name: Additional Rare Monsters
keywords.definition: Can spawn in Rare Monster Packs with larger pack sizes; each provides one modifier to the Pack's Minions.

keywords.name: Empowered Monster Minions
keywords.definition: Deal increased damage and have increased health; Empowerment alone does not increase rewards.

keywords.name: Abandoned City
keywords.definition: Monsters replaced by Undead (50% chance to drop non-equipment items); 25% increased Chests in the area.

keywords.name: Exceptional Item
keywords.definition: Has Quality over maximum or an additional Augment Socket; some High Tier Rare items can drop as an Exceptional Normal Item.

keywords.name: Embrace of the Wild
keywords.definition: Bear Spirit's Allies in its Presence gain 2% of maximum Life regenerated per second; 8% of their damage taken goes to the Bear Spirit.

keywords.name: Biome
keywords.definition: Areas found across Endgame Maps; Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water are common; Cities and special biomes are less likely.

keywords.name: Invaded City
keywords.definition: Natural inhabitants plus 15 extra Packs of an invading faction (Ezomyte, Faridun or Vaal), gaining that faction's Biome bonuses.

keywords.name: Crafted Modifiers
keywords.definition: Modifiers guaranteed by certain crafting methods; an item can only have one; shown in lighter blue.

keywords.name: Grand Mirror
keywords.definition: Reflects the Map Boss; when bosses are defeated Delirium fog spreads to nearby Maps; at 100% one Map becomes a Simulacrum.

keywords.name: Mountain's Teachings
keywords.definition: Ascendancy effect: attacks deal 15% more damage; hits of up to 30% of max Life deal 40% less; 50% more Stun Threshold; lost after 20 seconds without gaining any.

keywords.name: Wombgifts
keywords.definition: Found in Breaches and grown on The Genesis Tree; four types: Lavish, Ornate, Banded and Signet.

keywords.name: Rite of the Nameless
keywords.definition: Group of Maps with Ritual Altars and a Map Boss; completing all Ritual Altars drops an Effigy Piece.

keywords.name: Effigy
keywords.definition: Effigy Pieces are placed on an incomplete Effigy in Caer Tarth to complete the Rite of the Nameless.

keywords.name: Low Runic Ward
keywords.definition: You are on Low Runic Ward at 35% of maximum Runic Ward or less.

keywords.name: Savage Hit
keywords.definition: A Hit that removes at least 15% of Maximum Life.

keywords.name: Foretold Proliferation
keywords.definition: Completing this Map applies a specified Modifier to other Maps in the Rite of the Nameless.

keywords.name: Foretold Bounty
keywords.definition: The first list of Favours at Ritual Altars in this Map will contain the specified Item.

keywords.name: Basic Maps
keywords.definition: Maps with no special interaction with areas or access requirements; excludes Unique, Deadly Boss, Precursor Tower, Expedition and Quest Areas.

keywords.name: Base Type
keywords.definition: An item's specific variety, granting inherent properties and often Level or Attribute requirements.

keywords.name: Mage's Legacy
keywords.definition: A set of fourteen possible Legacies, each granting a different bonus; only one instance of each can apply at a time.

keywords.name: Legacy of Amethyst
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +45% to Chaos Resistance.

keywords.name: Legacy of Basalt
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 150% increased Armour.

keywords.name: Legacy of Bismuth
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +45% to all Elemental Resistances.

keywords.name: Legacy of Diamond
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 75% increased Critical Hit Chance.

keywords.name: Legacy of Gold
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 45% increased Rarity of Items found.

keywords.name: Legacy of Granite
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +2000 to Armour.

keywords.name: Legacy of Jade
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +2000 to Evasion Rating.

keywords.name: Legacy of Quicksilver
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 30% increased Movement Speed.

keywords.name: Legacy of Ruby
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +60% to Fire Resistance and +5% to Maximum Fire Resistance.

keywords.name: Legacy of Sapphire
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +60% to Cold Resistance and +5% to Maximum Cold Resistance.

keywords.name: Legacy of Silver
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 30% increased Skill Speed.

keywords.name: Legacy of Stibnite
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 150% increased Evasion Rating.

keywords.name: Legacy of Sulphur
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting 60% increased Damage, and Consecrated Ground within 2.5 metres while stationary.

keywords.name: Legacy of Topaz
keywords.definition: Mage's Legacy granting +60% to Lightning Resistance and +5% to Maximum Lightning Resistance.

keywords.name: Bonus Reward
keywords.definition: Guaranteed rewards from some Remnant encounters, granted to nearby party members who have not claimed them.

keywords.name: Verisium Infusion
keywords.definition: Substitute for any Elemental Infusion; lasts 20 seconds or until Consumed; maximum equal to the Elemental Infusion limit (3 by default).

keywords.name: Secured Strongbox
keywords.definition: Strongbox guarded by additional Packs of Rare Monsters; may roll modifiers that add Monster Modifiers to those Rares.

keywords.name: Overencumbered
keywords.definition: Debuff that Slows by 10%; reapplication stacks and refreshes its duration.

keywords.name: Broken Boss Faces
keywords.definition: Boss Encounter icons on the World Screen can be broken by beating the encounter; Rare Monster icons give no bonus.

keywords.name: Sinister Jewel Sockets
keywords.definition: Sockets entirely disconnected from the rest of the passive tree, so Jewel radius effects do not apply to them.

keywords.name: Socket-bound Augments
keywords.definition: Augments that permanently fill any Augment Socket they are placed into; cannot be removed, replaced or extracted.

keywords.name: Cascadable Skills
keywords.definition: Warcries and non-Channelling area or targeted Spells can Cascade or Echo; a Repeating Spell will not Cascade or Echo while Repeating.

keywords.name: Anaemia
keywords.definition: Debuff allowing more than 10 Corrupted Blood debuffs to be applied to a target.

keywords.name: Phased Form
keywords.definition: Chronomancer Ascendancy notable: take 30% less damage; 4 seconds after taking Enemy Hit damage, take 30% of that Hit's damage.

keywords.name: Kalguuran Support Gem Limit
keywords.definition: Kalguuran Support Gems usable by level: 1 (Level 1+), 2 (17+), 3 (33+), 4 (45+), 5 (65+), 6 (80+).

keywords.name: Precursor Terraformer
keywords.definition: Activating it changes nearby Basic Maps to the displayed Biome.

keywords.name: Ancient Modifiers
keywords.definition: Fragments of Precursor power adding varied bonus effects to areas in the Precursor Fortress and beyond.

keywords.name: Congealed Mist
keywords.definition: A mysterious Augment that "shifts and shimmers."

keywords.name: Seals and Sealed Skills
keywords.definition: Skills that gain Seals when used by you; using a Sealed Skill breaks its Seals for a benefit scaled to their number.

keywords.name: Raven-Touched
keywords.definition: Items warped by Tangmazu that can be instilled with a Notable Passive at the Withered Willow.

keywords.name: Great Beast
keywords.definition: Map Bosses marked by Hilda; defeating one earns Hilda's Favour.

keywords.name: Hilda's Favour
keywords.definition: Reward of an Atlas Master point to spend on Atlas Keystones.

keywords.name: Temple Currency
keywords.definition: Currency items found mainly in the Temple, typically interacting with Corrupted Items.

keywords.name: Anomaly Map
keywords.definition: Maps with added access requirements; their bosses are Deadly and may drop an extra lineage support.

keywords.name: Landmark Area
keywords.definition: Atlas areas that can be entered repeatedly and do not require a Waystone to access.

keywords.name: Hiveblood
keywords.definition: Used to birth Wombgifts from The Genesis Tree; maximum 100,000.

keywords.name: Vivid Spirit
keywords.definition: Azmeri Spirit type: increases Skill Speed of affected monsters; Possessed monsters drop Dexterity items.

keywords.name: Wild Spirit
keywords.definition: Azmeri Spirit type: increases Toughness of affected monsters; Possessed monsters drop Strength items.

keywords.name: Primal Spirit
keywords.definition: Azmeri Spirit type: increases damage of affected monsters; Possessed monsters drop Intelligence items.

keywords.name: Puppet Master
keywords.definition: Stacking Buff (max 5): 10% increased Skill Speed and 10% reduced Movement Speed Penalty with Command Skills, Minions +10% damage with Command Skills; each stack lasts 8 seconds.

keywords.name: Aldur's Legacies
keywords.definition: Augments based on Ezomyte or Kalguuran Uniques; only one of this type may be socketed at a time.

keywords.name: Corrupted Monsters
keywords.definition: Monsters with an extra Corrupted Modifier that may raise difficulty and reward or make them easier to defeat.

keywords.name: Xesht's Fervour
keywords.definition: Ailith skill increasing the Effectiveness of Monsters in Breach Hive encounters.

keywords.name: Dreamer's Sight
keywords.definition: Ailith skill creating a zone that upgrades Breach Monster Rarity, up to Rare, once per monster.

keywords.name: Escalating Threats
keywords.definition: Adds a Modifier to the Simulacrum area that applies to all remaining waves.

keywords.name: Apex Predators
keywords.definition: Adds an extra Boss to the encounter, summoned into all remaining Simulacrum waves.

keywords.name: Pure Emotions
keywords.definition: Adds additional monster packs to the encounter, carried into all remaining Simulacrum waves.

keywords.name: Otherworldly Nemesis
keywords.definition: Ailith skill adding a Pack with a Rare Monster to each wave.

keywords.name: Dreamer's Inspiration
keywords.definition: Ailith skill creating a zone that adds a Modifier to Rare Breach Monsters; a Rare can only have one added Modifier.

keywords.name: Dreamer's Gift
keywords.definition: Ailith skill sacrificing half her life for 100% increased Item Rarity in Breach Hives.

keywords.name: Dreamer's Might
keywords.definition: Ailith skill sacrificing half her life for 1000% more Damage and immunity to Damage for 10 seconds.

keywords.name: Verisium Sentry
keywords.definition: Kalguuran remnants in Expeditions that follow the player, adding Runic Modifiers to monsters.

keywords.name: Power Rune
keywords.definition: Upgrades all other Runic Modifiers on the Remnant to a more powerful variant.

keywords.name: Fire Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Extra Fire Damage.

keywords.name: Cold Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Extra Cold Damage.

keywords.name: Lightning Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Extra Lightning Damage.

keywords.name: Tempest Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters cannot be Shocked or Chilled; all damage contributes to Shock and Chill magnitude.

keywords.name: Momentum Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Increased Movement Speed that cannot be Slowed below base.

keywords.name: Bloodletting Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Life Leech, cannot have Life Leeched from, and inflict Corrupted Blood on Hit.

keywords.name: Stone Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Armoured, increased Stun Threshold and Earthly Prison.

keywords.name: Adaptive Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Adaptation.

keywords.name: Arcane Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Extra Energy Shield and trigger a Stunning nova when Energy Shield is depleted.

keywords.name: Toxic Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain a chance to Poison on Hit, Toxic Volatiles on death, and all damage contributes to Poison magnitude.

keywords.name: Electrocuting Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Extra Lightning Damage, Lightning Damage Electrocutes, and Shocked Ground Trails.

keywords.name: Protective Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters periodically gain Verisium Proximity Shields.

keywords.name: Cyclonic Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain a chance to inflict Exposure on Hit, Armour Break on Hit and Wither on Hit.

keywords.name: Vision Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Reflect Curses and chance to Reflect Shock and Chill.

keywords.name: Tidal Rune
keywords.definition: The Remnant gains the ability to Conjure Tidal Waves.

keywords.name: Rebirth Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain a chance to Rebirth on death.

keywords.name: Prismatic Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain All Damage can Shock, Chill and Ignite, and Increased Elemental Resistances.

keywords.name: Gasp Rune
keywords.definition: Volcanic Rune: monsters gain Extra Fire Damage, All Damage can Ignite, and Ignited Ground Trails.

keywords.name: Moon Rune
keywords.definition: The Remnant gains the ability to Conjure moon beams.

keywords.name: Celestial Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain a chance for Fire, Cold and Lightning Explosions on death.

keywords.name: Opulent Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Increased Monster Rarity.

keywords.name: Rage Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters periodically Enrage.

keywords.name: Wisdom Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Increased Experience.

keywords.name: Sky Rune
keywords.definition: The Remnant gains the ability to Conjure Elemental Tornados.

keywords.name: Earth Rune
keywords.definition: The Remnant gains the ability to Conjure Earthly Spires.

keywords.name: Life Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Shared Life.

keywords.name: Bond Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters may transfer a Mod on death; the Remnant gains increased chance to spawn Rare Monsters; Rare Monsters have more Monster Modifiers.

keywords.name: Ward Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters are Protected by Runic Ward.

keywords.name: Soul Rune
keywords.definition: Monsters gain Union of Souls.

keywords.name: Death Rune
keywords.definition: Slain Monsters may merge into stronger Monsters.

keywords.name: Oath Rune
keywords.definition: A Monster summons Allies.

keywords.name: Time Rune
keywords.definition: Slain Monsters may respawn as a higher Rarity.

keywords.name: Ruin
keywords.definition: Gained if you are hit by a Stalking Shade inside the Trial of Chaos; fail the Trials on reaching 7 Ruin.

keywords.name: Abyssal Fissure
keywords.definition: A group of areas containing Abysses, all of one faction; the final area leads to that faction's boss; Abyssal monsters grow stronger further along.

keywords.name: Released Azmeri Spirits
keywords.definition: Azmeri Spirits released from Possessed monsters; chance to manifest with a portion of the empowerment, at 1% per 2% empowerment.

keywords.name: Vaal Relics
keywords.definition: Found in Frigid Bluffs Grand Expeditions and as a modifier on Expedition Tablets; unearthed like Verisium Remnants, with predefined modifiers.
